description: Stage and commit. Returns the new SHA, or committed:false when there was nothing staged.

cwd.description: Repository to run in. Defaults to the workspace root.

message.description: Commit message. Passed as a single `-m` argument.

stage_all.description: Stage every change first (`git add -A`). On by default, matching what an editor's commit command does; pass false to commit only the index.

committed.description: False when there was nothing staged to commit.

sha.description: Full SHA of the new commit, when one was made.
